## Holes — walled-on objects that NO scanned file creates

None. Every walled-on object has a producer in the scanned files.

## Landmines — one object name created by files in DIFFERENT units

Each unit's schedule overwrites the same session name; the last file sourced wins. Edges above prefer the producer inside the consumer's own unit.

## Two-part files — a later section walls on what an earlier section built

`source()` runs top to bottom and stops at the first wall. If section 1 dies, section 2's wall fires with the names below — and everything after it never runs (the rushing schedules' composite pack is why rushing needs run defense first).
